ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two dice placed side by side. The visible top face of the left die has 1 dot, and the front face has 2 dots. The visible top face of the right die has 4 dots, the front face has 6 dots, and the right side face has 2 dots. Reasoning: The problem asks for the sum of the numbers of dots on all invisible faces. The numbers of dots on the six faces of each standard die are 1 to 6, and the total is 1+2+3+4+5+6=21. The total number of dots on the two dice is 21×2=42. The sum of the visible dots in the figure is 1+2+4+6+2=15. Therefore, the sum of the numbers of dots on the invisible faces is 42−15=27.

method.method_draft: Read the image first: there are two dice placed side by side. On the left die, the visible top face has 1 pip and the visible front face has 2 pips. On the right die, the visible top face has 4 pips, the visible front face has 6 pips, and the visible right side face has 2 pips. Read the text as asking for the sum of all pips on faces not visible in the picture. Use the standard die fact that one die has faces numbered 1 through 6, so the total pips on each die are 1+2+3+4+5+6=21. For two dice, the total is 42. The visible sum is 1+2+4+6+2=15, so the invisible sum is 42−15=27.
